messages:
alex.sales: Passing Slate Integrations to CS — MSA signed this AM. Need: Dedicated capacity (US-EAST), Okta SSO, audit logs 2y, and a 30-day pilot. Pilot expected ~4k tokens/day, ramp to 60k/day on go-live. Customer mentioned platform consolidation in ~9 months, flag renewal.

sam.csm: Thanks Alex. Can you drop infra contact + where creds live? Also want to confirm pilot success metrics and any special compliance asks.

alex.sales: Infra lead is nina@slate.io. Provisioning creds in 1Password item: Slate-Provision-1815. Finance provisionally approved a 60-day credit up to $2,000; will send confirmation email tonight. Pilot success metrics proposal: p95 < 275ms, classification drift <2%, and feature adoption >= 3 widgets.

sam.csm: Ok owners: Sam = CSM, Maria = Support (primary), Jin = Eng (private/dedicated lead). I'll run the Day 0 checklist and invite Slate to the kickoff.

maria.support: I'll open SUP-9222 for onboarding triage and add runbook items: Okta metadata import, SAML test accounts, cert exchange, firewall allowlist, KMS integration notes, and dashboard stub. ETA ticket by EOD.

oncall-bot: infra-request queued: dedicated-us-east-slate (owner: jin.eng)

jin.eng: Noted. Need CIDR ranges and KMS key ARN from Nina. Proposed smoke test window: 2024-06-10 14:00 ET. Also: Slate plans to request private model variants Q3; please open RFC-2184 for quant/validation.

sam.csm: Sam here — I'll request CIDR/KMS in the kickoff invite and set Account Health = onboarding: in progress. Renewal Watch = medium-high due consolidation signal. Action: set quarterly check-ins, product adoption dashboard, and exec-touch schedule.

alex.sales: Sent credit confirmation: "Slate confirms 60-day pilot credit up to $2,000" — forwarded to finance and cc'd @sam.csm.

maria.support: SUP-9222 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-9222 — attachments: onboarding-checklist.md, dashboard-prototype.png. Adding monitoring alerts: p95 > 300ms, route-error-rate > 0.8%.

jin.eng: Provisioning job started (infra-4890). Will run canary after Nina provides network/CIDR. If peering is required we'll need a maintenance window. Opening RFC-2184 now and linking SUP-9222.

sam.csm: Owners & next steps (short):
- Sam (CSM): kickoff invite, docs, success metrics, QBR cadence
- Maria (Support): SUP-9222 triage + dashboard + runbook (ETA: ticket today)
- Jin (Eng): provision dedicated pool, RFC-2184 (ETA: provisioning queued)
- Alex (Sales): confirm written credit and intro to Nina (ETA: EOD)

alex.sales: Will intro Tina (product owner) if Sam wants a walkthrough — LMK. Also noting renewal risk: medium-high due to consolidation.

sam.csm: Please cc me on intros. Captured next sync after smoke test. If blocked, escalate in #eng-oncall and tag @jin.eng. :white_check_mark:
